data.title: Egumi Legacy
data.synopsis:
Floating in a certain ocean is an island called "EGU Island." The sole entertainment on this island is listening to the songstress, "End of the World." Day after day, the islanders are enchanted by her singing. However, this tranquil time is shattered in an instant. Since the disappearance of the songstress, the island has been filled with "anger," "doubt," and "anxiety." Various thoughts and intentions begin to stir...A licking war unfolds around, "End of the World!" The one who holds her destiny is the legendary legacy "EGUMI Legacy."

(Source: Ani-One Asia)

data.synopsis:
In the year 0068 of the Universal Century, Casval Rem Deikun's life is thrown into chaotic disarray after the assassination of his father, a prolific figure in the crusade towards civil rights for people who live away from the Earth's surface. Casval and his sister Artesia receive aid from soldiers who were loyal to their father, and the siblings are whisked away from their home, separated, and thrown into a twisted fate that sees them come into their own as soldiers and adults.

Years before stealing the name Char Aznable or his "Red Comet" moniker, Casval must contend with the rise of a militarized version of his father's ideology and his own vengeful nature as intergalactic war molds him into a legendary mobile suit pilot. 

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.synopsis:
Wei Ran, a college graduate, was accidentally led into a world he never thought existed by a cat. When he was trying to find a way to return home, he learned that the only train that could take him back to the human world would only arrive in half a year. He could only temporarily live in the shop run by Mao Mao Yaya - Guaixiang Sale. Just when life seemed to be settling down, Wei Ran unexpectedly discovered that no matter where he went, dragon scales would appear. And every time the dragon scales appear, it causes completely different strange effects...

data.title: Baise Shandian
data.synopsis:
After a crushing defeat in a major tournament, Zhang Ruoyi, forced to abandon her professional career, returned to school. In the unfamiliar environment, table tennis, which had once cast a shadow over her, became a ray of light piercing through her confusion—on the table, she made teammates; off the court, she gained friendships. This time, the young woman decided to give it her all and swing her racket towards the future.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

data.title: Bai Fa Shen La
title_synonyms: 民调局异闻录之白发沈辣
data.synopsis:
Shen La, a special investigator of the "Poll Bureau" of the mysterious incident management agency, was seriously injured in the execution of his mission. When he was about to die, he accepted the inheritance of Wu Rendi, the director of the Sixth Office - a "seed" containing mysterious power. After regaining consciousness, Wu Rendi's senior brother Guangren accepted him as his disciple. In order to find the fragments of the Tianli Diagram, Shen La, after going through the Tianshan Wolf Tomb, energy backlash, foundation conspiracy and other incidents, was finally recognized by Wu Rendi and received the ancient artifact-the Twin Swords of Crime and Punishment given by him. At the same time, the problem of the insider in the polling bureau became more complicated and confusing, and Shen La and her partner Sun Desheng went into battle again.

(Source: Bilibili, Google translated)

In front of them, there appeared the sophomore drama club senior and iceberg male god Gao Shu, and his mysterious roommate Ouyang who is highly socially afraid... At this point, the actors on the stage have gathered. Will they take off their masks and be honest? treat each other; or will they each show their special powers and create a campus drama of intrigue?
